description: This PHP script manages the association between test plans and test projects in the TestLink open-source test management system. It includes functionalities for verifying user permissions, updating test plan associations, and rendering a web interface for managing test plans and projects.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class representing test projects, providing methods to retrieve all test projects.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A class encapsulating Smarty templating for rendering HTML views.

methods.name: changeTestProjectForTestPlan
methods.description: Updates the database to associate a test plan with a test project.
